establishedMethods.boundary: The official documentation defines alignment, PSF-star, central-pixel-adjustment, and aperture-star diagnostics. RC70 applies those published diagnostics; it does not introduce them.
STScI documents four short-wave detectors arranged with physical gaps. RC70 uses that instrument topology to predeclare which exposures can overlap each reference tile.

The DOLPHOT JWST validation literature reports detector- and epoch-dependent PSF and aperture effects. RC70 narrows the current archive problem to an auditable detector support check before injections.

The Perfect Host study supplies the scientific target and published Cepheid set. RC70 does not reinterpret its distance result; it tests whether a later exposure-level intervention has a valid measurement operator.

testedCombination: Outcome-blind WCS tiling plus a predeclared detector-to-exposure support partition, followed by a real DOLPHOT 3.0 reference run and independent parsing, tests whether zero matches are structural zeros rather than alignment failures. This is a reproducible validation design, not a claim of method priority or patentability.
noveltyBoundary: The constituent instrument geometry, WCS, photometry software, and quality diagnostics are established. The research contribution of this cycle is their falsifiable combination at the exact handoff left by RC69, with scientific inference stopped unless the measurement-operator receipts pass.
